marketMood: Risk-mixed: Treasury buybacks cap the 30-year yield rally and lift gold, but chip stocks and Japan's Nikkei extend losses on rate anxiety — FOMC minutes today and Jackson Hole next week are the next key catalysts.

upcomingEvents.event: Fed Chair Warsh keynote at Jackson Hole
US Treasury expanded long-bond buyback operations take effect

topStories.headline: Bessent Doubles Long-Bond Buybacks, Jolts Debt Market
topStories.summary: Treasury Secretary Bessent announced the US will at least double maximum buyback size for longer-dated Treasuries from $2B to $4B per operation, effective September 9, to support orderly market functioning after yields hit multi-decade highs.
topStories.marketImpact: US 30Y yield fell ~10bps from 5.34% (19-year high) to 5.18% ↓; dollar slid to a 3-month low ↓; gold surged to highest since June ↑; broad equity rebound

topStories.headline: Nikkei Slides 2.9% as Chip and AI Stocks Buckle on Yield Anxiety
topStories.summary: Japan's benchmark fell for a second straight session led by Kioxia (-10%), Furukawa Electric (-9.8%), Tokyo Electron (-4.7%), and Advantest (-4.4%) as elevated global bond yields — with Japan's 10Y at 30-year highs — sapped risk appetite from the AI trade.
topStories.marketImpact: Nikkei 225 ↓ 2.9% to ~65,500; Topix ↓ 2.4%; global AI supply-chain names under pressure ↓

topStories.headline: HKEX Posts Record H1 Profit as AI IPO Boom Fuels Surge in Turnover
topStories.summary: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing reported first-half net profit rose 24% to a record HK$10.57 billion, beating analyst estimates, with revenue and investment income up 19% to HK$16.7 billion driven by surging IPO activity and record trading volumes.
topStories.marketImpact: 0388.HK ↑ ~1.6%; positive read-through for regional exchanges and investment banks active in Hong Kong listings ↑

topStories.headline: Trump Presses Congress to Pass Clarity Act at White House Crypto Summit
topStories.summary: President Trump hosted leading crypto executives from Coinbase, Ripple, Gemini, and Robinhood alongside CFTC and SEC chairs, calling the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act critical to US tech leadership — the bill has cleared the House but a Senate floor vote remains elusive.
topStories.marketImpact: Bitcoin near $60,000 ↑ on sentiment; COIN watch ↑; analysts peg bill-passage probability at ~10% this year — any Senate progress would be a major catalyst

topStories.headline: Middle East Conflict Chokes Strait of Hormuz, Oil Holds Near $92
topStories.summary: Only ~8 vessels crossed the Strait of Hormuz on Monday versus a pre-war average of 120 as the US-Iran conflict continues to disrupt a fifth of global oil flows, with Saudi Arabia and the UAE seeking alternative export routes.
topStories.marketImpact: Brent crude near $92/bbl ↑ (6-month high); oil on a four-day winning streak ↑; persistent inflationary pressure on global economies; energy stocks watch ↑

topStories.headline: Gold Hits Highest Since June as Treasury Buybacks Ease Yield Pressure
topStories.summary: Gold rallied to $4,451/oz — its highest level since June 2026 — as the Treasury's buyback announcement eased long-bond yields and weakened the dollar, extending gold's roughly 11% gain over the past four weeks.
topStories.marketImpact: GLD ↑; gold miners ↑; watch for continuation if 30Y yields remain suppressed below 5.2%

topStories.headline: NVIDIA Earnings Loom August 26 as AI Revenue Locomotive Accelerates
topStories.summary: With Q2 FY2027 results due August 26, analysts project $93–95B in quarterly revenue — up ~67% year-on-year — and expect another beat as Nvidia maintains ~80-85% market share in AI training chips.
topStories.marketImpact: NVDA watch ahead of results ↑ directional lean; any miss or soft guidance would ripple through the entire global AI supply chain ↓

topStories.headline: FOMC Minutes Drop Today — Warsh's Jackson Hole Tone in Focus
topStories.summary: The minutes of the July FOMC meeting publish today; three of 12 committee members dissented in favour of a rate hike, and markets will parse how close the committee came to tightening — ahead of Fed Chair Warsh's first Jackson Hole keynote on August 28.
topStories.marketImpact: SPY and rate-sensitive sectors watch; hawkish tone could pressure equities and extend bond selloff ↓; dovish lean would provide relief ↑

topStories.headline: Xiaomi Surges While China Unicom and SMIC Sink in Hong Kong Session
topStories.summary: In the Tuesday Hong Kong session, Xiaomi rose 5.1% on strong consumer electronics demand while China Unicom plunged 12.8% and SMIC fell 4.6% amid heavy tech sector selling, reflecting diverging fortunes across China's tech sector.
topStories.marketImpact: 1810.HK ↑; 0762.HK ↓; 0981.HK ↓; HK tech sector split between consumer strength and telecom/semiconductor weakness
